ideas.pitch: An AI-powered application that coordinates local student volunteers in Charlottesville to group and transport nearby seniors to grocery stores, social events, and appointments.
ideas.title: Hoos-Out: Student Senior Companion & Volunteer Coordinator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact grand-prize winning pattern of solving local community issues with measurable social impact, which appeals deeply to university judges and local hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutrition and wellness assistant optimized for college student budgets in Charlottesville, generating personalized meal plans based on local grocery store sales and nutritional needs.
ideas.title: Cavalier-Cents: Student Micro-Budget and Meal Planning AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets a major pain point felt by every student judge and attendee in the room—eating well on a strict student budget.

ideas.pitch: A Poisson-regression and ML-backed forecasting tool using historical campus and city safety data to predict incident hotspots and optimize late-night campus shuttle routes in real time.
ideas.title: Grounds-Guard: Campus Safety Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard statistical engineering combined with practical campus utility, a combination that stands out among standard web apps.

ideas.pitch: A localized, escrow-backed marketplace for university students to safely buy, sell, and trade textbooks, dorm furniture, and services using simple crypto or simulated fiat escrow mechanics.
ideas.title: Hoos-Trade: Local Student-to-Student Exchange Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, recurring logistical problem for students moving in and out of Charlottesville apartments and dorms every semester.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring interface tracking urban sprawl, tree canopy changes, and industrial land compliance around the Charlottesville and Albemarle County area.
ideas.title: C-Ville Eco-Monitor: Satellite Land & Green Space Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies advanced spatial intelligence and computer vision to a tangible local environmental dataset, showcasing high technical execution within the 35-hour limit.
